div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://awatson1978.github.io/aerospace-medicine-ig/CodeSystem/telemedicine-modality-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: Synchronous video consultation between crew and ground
Asynchronous transmission of clinical data and images for later review
Text-based clinical communication with time delay
Continuous remote physiological monitoring from ground
Autonomous or semi-autonomous AI-based clinical triage
Procedure performed by crew with real-time or near-real-time guidance from ground
